description: This is a server-side route handler for a login page implementing OAuth 2.0 with Google, using PKCE for security. It manages the OAuth flow, including redirect URL generation, handling callback with authorization code, exchanging code for tokens via a Django backend, and setting secure cookies.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Main entry point invoked on page load, handling OAuth callback, user session check, or generating OAuth login URL.

methods.name: handleOAuthCallback
methods.description: Processes OAuth callback, validates state, exchanges code for tokens, and sets secure cookies.

methods.name: generateOAuthUrl
methods.description: Creates a Google OAuth URL with PKCE, saves verifier and state in cookies.

methods.name: getCookieOptions
methods.description: Helper to generate cookie options with environment-specific 'secure' flag.
